rationale: Rear-end collision causing vehicle damage (totaled) and injury to the policyholder—textbook auto claim involving collision damage and bodily injury from a motor vehicle accident.
claim_summary: Policyholder (Pat Morgan, POL-1003) rear-ended on Route 9 at 8:15am yesterday by vehicle traveling ~35 mph; vehicle totaled with trunk crushed into back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Third-party insurance information available on police report. High-severity claim requiring vehicle valuation and injury assessment.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled vehicle; trunk crushed into back seat

rationale: Tree fell on policyholder's parked vehicle causing damage to hood and windshield; this is a classic auto comprehensive claim (natural event damage to insured vehicle).
claim_summary: Maple tree from policyholder's front yard blown down in windstorm and fell onto parked vehicle, damaging hood and windshield. Estimated damage $3,000–$8,000. Vehicle is drivable. No injuries.

case_facts.description: Maple tree from front yard blown down by wind, fell on parked car
